content: {"episode_id":"ep-05035","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"The claim for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was denied under CO-197 for lack of precertification or authorization prior to the service date. The clinical indication note documents that \"the patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks, occurring in the context of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation,\" consistent with diagnosis codes R55, G45.9, and I48.0. Per that note, mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered \"to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate and rhythm control strategies.\" We request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial on this documented indication for the outstanding balance of 555.69."}
